title: Stellar Nursery - Demo - would love feedback!
author: PortiaPlaysDev
selftext:
Hey all, I deleted my original post so that I could post this properly. -

Love that this community exists. I used AI Claude code to put this game together. I will be voice acting this game and we used music from composers. All of the writing and creative direction were all ran by my husband and I.

Stellar Nursery is an idle game about reigniting a dead solar system, narrated by P.O.R.T.I.A., an AI who remembers what it was like to be human. It's not just flavor text either, story choices during the reignite actually change your resources, not just the narration.

Free browser demo: [https://portiaplays.itch.io/stellar-nursery](https://portiaplays.itch.io/stellar-nursery)

Would love thoughts on whether the opening lands and whether the pacing feels right for the genre. Also happy to hear about any bugs.
